messages:
Lena (eng-platform): Heads up — we're cutting over CI auth to ephemeral credentials next month. Long-lived deploy keys and PATs for pipelines will be deprecated. Migration window: 2026-06-10 -> 2026-07-01. Docs: https://intranet.redwood/ci-auth-migration :loudspeaker:
Samir: Timeline noted. Will this affect self-hosted runners?
Priya (infra): Yes — runners will request short-lived SSH certs from Vault via the new minting agent. No more static SSH keys on disk.
Jordan (SRE): Any breaking changes for GitHub Actions workflows?
Lena (eng-platform): Minimal changes. You need to add the OIDC audience and replace checkout + key steps with the new action. Example snippet:```yaml
permissions: write-all
steps:
  - name: Request ephemeral token
    uses: redwood/actions-request-ephemeral@v1
    with:
      audience: ci.redwood.io
      role: runner
```
Samir: Where's the migration guide? I want to update our monorepo CI templates.
Lena (eng-platform): Full guide here: https://intranet.redwood/ci-auth-migration#guide — includes template diffs, a test mode, and a rollback plan. Test mode lets you opt-in per-repo for 14 days without cutting off old tokens.
Priya (infra): For on-prem runners see the SSH cert helper snippet:```bash
vault write ssh-client-signer/sign/redwood role=ci-requester public_key=@~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
ssh -i /path/to/cert user@runner.internal
```
Jordan (SRE): What about emergency access if Vault is down?
Lena (eng-platform): We have a fallback: a short-lived emergency PAT service for infra ops only (requires 2-person approval via PagerDuty). Details in runbook link in the doc.
deploy-bot: Deployment triggered: ci-migration-docs @ 2026-05-01T16:12:30Z :white_check_mark:
Samir: Is there a way to test in CI without touching prod configs?
Lena (eng-platform): Yes — use the "ci-ephemeral-test" org flag and the test OIDC audience. Steps in the guide.
Priya (infra): We'll run a phased rollout: week 1 - infra repos, week 2 - platform services, week 3 - customer-facing repos.
Jordan (SRE): Please publish a list of repos that must migrate by the hard cutoff (2026-07-01).
Lena (eng-platform): Will publish by EOD tomorrow and create a migration channel. Ping @here when it's live.
Samir: Thx — will start updating templates this week.
Lena (eng-platform): Thanks all. If you hit issues, open an incident in #incidents and tag Priya/Jordan. :thumbsup:
